en: Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a large Romanesque‑Revival Catholic church with twin square towers, a rose window, and an arched main portal. The church stands at the top of a stairway, surrounded by trees and landscaped paths. In the foreground, a woman in early 20th‑century clothing stands near a path and a small cart. The right half of the card is mostly blank for writing. Red printed text at the top identifies the church and location; additional red text appears along the bottom edge.
